title: Digital Marketing Assistant
description:
Digital Marketing Assistant - York

Brooklyn Recruitment are currently working with a well established yet rapidly expanding abrasives tooling business. They are looking for a Digital Marketing Assistant to be office based in the York area. This is a brand new role to the business so is a great opportunity to really make it your own.

As Digital Marketing Assistant your role will be extremely varied, and your duties will include:
- Planning and executing digital marketing campaigns.
- Managing the social media channels.
- Creating social media posts and videos.
- Designing email campaigns.
- Updating the website.
- Ensuring the brand values are highlighted and all items are kept on brand.
- Assisting other members of the marketing team.
- Maintaining the marketing library.
- Other duties as required

As Digital Marketing Assistant, you will be rewarded with a generous salary, a pension scheme, 25 days holiday, a great team environment and a chance to really shape the digital marketing role.

The hours of work for this role of Digital Marketing Assistant are Mon - Fri 9am - 5pm.

To be suitable for this role of Digital Marketing Assistant you should have previous experience in a similar Marketing position, ideally from a tool / construction / DIY background, but all industries will be considered.

You should have great communication and organisational skills as well as having extensive social media experience. You should also hold a degree in Marketing or another Business related subject or alternatively have real life experience. Instagram is currently the main social media channel used but they would also like to branch out into TikTok and to further utilise Meta.

title: Marketing Assistant
description:
Marketing Assistant

Offering £26,000 - £28,000 Basic Salary plus Great Benefits

Harrogate

Our client is an established manufacturing business based in Harrogate. Now recruiting a Marketing Assistant to join their friendly and established marketing team. The successful candidate will provide hands-on support across digital marketing, graphic design and artwork coordination, website and CMS updates, email marketing, social media, events, webinars, product launches, reporting and marketing administration.

Marketing Assistant - Key Responsibilities
- Work closely with the Graphic Designer to support artwork requests, design amendments and the coordination of marketing materials.
- Provide graphic design and artwork support, helping manage and complete artwork requests and amendments. Complete artwork tasks such as flyers, business cards, certificates, CPD materials, minor product collateral amends, sales support documents and sector-specific templates. Assisting the Graphic Designer Lead on larger creative projects, such as product launches, packaging and new marketing materials.
- Support the digital marketing team to maintain creative and digital outputs, supporting social media content creation, scheduling, monitoring, reporting and recommendations for improved content performance.
- Support product launches and go-to-market activity, including digital marketing, sales team communications, lead generation, print, press, awareness activity and third-party supplier coordination.
- Take ownership of marketing actions for new starters and leavers within sales teams, including business cards, promotional items, photography, website updates, territory artwork, CRM and website lead allocation, communications groups and social media welcome content.
- Support PPC and paid digital activity by working with external suppliers and preparing campaign assets for awareness, performance and PMax activity.
- Manage the marketing inbox daily, responding to queries, completing actions, escalating where required and tracking next steps.
- Collate marketing performance data for the department, including website, social media, email and YouTube reporting.

Marketing Assistant - Candidate
- Detail orientated with strong Adobe InDesign skills.
- Graphic design experience is essential.
- Knowledge, experience or a genuine interest in digital marketing would be advantageous.
- Highly organised with strong time-management skills, excellent attention to detail, and a proactive attitude towards learning and developing new skills.
- Be team orientated, with the ability to work independently.

The Marketing Assistant position is offering £26,000 - £28,000 basic salary plus great benefits for the successful candidate! This is a full-time, permanent, site-based position in Harrogate.

All successful candidates will be contacted within 5 days of application for the position of Marketing Assistant. This vacancy is being advertised by Technical Prospects Ltd. The services advertised by Technical Prospects Ltd are those of an Employment Agency.

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Job Title: Marketing Executive
Location: Knaresborough
Salary: £26,000 - £30,000 per annum
Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:30 am - 4:30 pm

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Marketing Executive to join an established organisation in Knaresborough. This is a fantastic opportunity for a creative and enthusiastic individual to play an important role in delivering engaging marketing activity, creating compelling content and supporting campaigns that make a genuine difference.

Working closely with an experienced Marketing Manager and the wider team, you will be involved in a varied mix of marketing activities including social media, email campaigns, website content, creative design, events and communications.

Responsibilities of Marketing Executive:
- Create engaging content for digital, social media, email and other marketing channels
- Support the planning and delivery of marketing campaigns
- Write and edit content, ensuring accuracy, quality and brand consistency
- Manage and update website content
- Help grow and maintain social media channels
- Support email marketing activity and monitor campaign performance
- Create marketing materials and digital assets using tools such as Canva and Adobe
- Support promotional activity around events, including attending events when required
- Assist with PR, communications and media activity
- Use marketing data and analytics to measure performance and identify opportunities for improvement
- Maintain brand consistency across all marketing communications
- Work collaboratively with colleagues, external contacts and creative partners
- Bring fresh ideas, creativity and enthusiasm to the wider marketing function

Skills & Experience:
- A genuine interest in marketing, content and communications
- Previous marketing experience or a relevant degree, although recent graduates are encouraged to apply
- Strong written communication skills and excellent attention to detail
- Confidence creating content for social media and digital channels
- An interest in design, branding and visual content
- Good organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities
- Willingness to learn new systems, platforms and ways of working
- Positive, proactive and collaborative approach
- Confidence in contributing creative ideas and taking initiative

In return, you will receive a competitive salary of £26,000 - £30,000 per annum, alongside the opportunity to develop your marketing skills across a varied and engaging role. You will join a supportive team where creativity and initiative are encouraged with the opportunity to see your ideas translated into real campaigns and communications that have a positive impact. APPLY TODAY!

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Are you a marketing executive looking for a new dynamic role within an established marketing and digital team in the North Yorkshire area?

Are you looking to work for a business that values its employees and customers alike? Would you like to work across the business and support the marketing ideas across different departments?

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with good all round generalist marketing experience who is eager to contribute ideas and take ownership of projects.

What the Marketing Executive job involves

You will play a crucial role in supporting the marketing team across a broad range of activities, helping to elevate the company's brand and engage with clients.
- Creating engaging content, including blog posts, web content, press releases and other written materials.
- Creating SEO / GEO optimised content.
- Support the wider team to implement the marketing strategy.
- Developing and implementing graphic design elements for various marketing collateral.
- Coordinating and attending events.
- Supporting and attending a variety of events, including sector-specific, networking, charity, and careers events.
- Collaborating with teams across the business to align marketing efforts with business objectives.
- Crafting compelling advertisements for PPC campaigns.
- Creating internal content for employees to see what the wider business is involved with.
- Working with external agencies to make sure that projects are on brand and of the high quality needed.

This is a fast-paced and varied role that requires an individual who can manage multiple priorities and is keen to immerse themselves in the business.

Skills required

We are looking for a candidate with proven all-round marketing experience who can hit the ground running. Ideal candidates will possess:
- Demonstrable generalist marketing experience.
- Experience in copy writing with strong attention to detail.
- Ability to create diverse content.
- A proactive and self-sufficient approach, with the ability to work independently.
- The ability to think creatively and develop new ideas.

Some digital marketing experience, such as PPC and SEO optimisation, would be highly advantageous to support the team's digital efforts and reduce reliance on a single digital specialist.

Other information
- Working full-time Monday to Friday
- 24 days holiday plus bank holidays
- Car Parking available
- Potential for flexible working / Hybrid working
- Other benefits are available

This vacancy is being advertised through KD Recruitment Limited who are operating as an Employment Agency.

Due to the volume of applications we receive if you have not heard from us within 2 weeks, please assume you have not been short listed for this particular role.

title: Paid Media Specialist - Hybrid working
description:
Are you passionate about Paid Media with hands-on skills in executing successful PPC and Paid Social campaigns?

We are thrilled to be working with a growing, well-established supplier of building equipment, who have an international remit and a reputation for delivering high quality and well-engineered products. They drive revenue through ecommerce and are currently seeking a Paid Media Specialist to join their team in East Yorkshire to deliver and optimise large-scale, in-house paid advertising and paid social campaigns.

This is a hands-on performance marketing role that goes considerably further than simply maintaining campaigns. We are looking for someone who can understand the commercial objective behind advertising, identify opportunities, control spend, challenge performance, test new approaches and clearly explain what is happening within the accounts and why.

Key responsibilities include:
- Day to day paid media strategy and ownership across the UK and US businesses
- Ownership of Microsoft and Google Ads including search, shopping & Performance Max
- Own paid social advertising, including Meta and the continued development of additional channels
- Work with Google Merchant Center, Microsoft Advertising and other relevant commerce/feed platforms
- Measurement, tracking, attribution, performance analysis and reporting

The successful applicant must have:
- Strong professional experience developing and managing paid media accounts
- Significant hands-on Google Ads experience including Performance Max
- Experience managing Meta and Microsoft Advertising
- Strong Google Shopping and eCommerce advertising knowledge

The successful candidate will be an experienced PPC Strategist, PPC Manager, Paid Advertising, Paid Search or Paid Media specialist, with proven experience of creating and managing large-scale search and shopping campaigns. The role could suit a PPC Executive from an agency, looking to step into more of a strategic and focussed role that would hold greater levels of accountability and more opportunities to hone their skills in-house.

This is a rewarding and unique opportunity for a seasoned Paid Media professional to perform a business critical, in-house role that delivers real impact. Due to the location of the office, a driving license and car is essential for commuting on a hybrid basis. This could be commutable from Hull, Beverley, York, Selby, Goole, Hornsea or Bridlington.
